text:
Sasha (ops): pager triggered — genqueue-usw elevated latency and 5xxs ~3.2% starting 09:12 UTC. Opening thread. Oncall please join the bridge: https://meet.redwood/b/xyz

IncidentBot: page routed to Maya (oncall). Incident ID: INC-2026-0789. Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/b/xyz. Pager time: 09:12 UTC.

Maya (oncall): joining bridge. first checks: are nodes OOMing? any recent deploys?

Raj (eng-sre): looking at metrics — CPU on g-serve-xx nodes at 87%, queue length up x6. KV cache hit unchanged. seeing increased tokenization latency in tokenizer service.

Maya (oncall): thanks. rolling restart small batch of g-serve-xx now, will monitor.

Sasha (ops): please prepare an initial statuspage update and a customer impact matrix draft. keep it short.

Ana (product): customer impact (draft): Some API requests to generation endpoints in US-West may experience higher latency and intermittent 5xxs. Affects hosted generation (text & streaming) in us-west only, ~3% of requests. Embeddings unaffected. No data loss.

Tom (support): ticket volume increasing, a couple enterprise customers pinging us. putting them on priority message list.

Raj (eng-sre): tried quick rollback to previous model variant — no change. proposing temporary routing of new requests to genqueue-eu until us-west stabilizes. can we enable region-fallback?

Maya (oncall): enabling fallback now (ETA ~2m). toggling feature flag region-fallback=on.

Sasha (ops): statuspage initial draft (please review/edit):

```
We are investigating elevated latency and increased error rates for generation requests in US-West (started ~09:12 UTC). Some customers may experience higher latency or intermittent 5xx errors. Our engineering team is actively investigating and has initiated mitigations including rolling restarts and regional fallback routing. We will post updates every 15 minutes or as the situation changes. Incident ID: INC-2026-0789.
```

Jamie (legal): wording tweak: avoid "customers may" -> prefer "Some requests to the generation API in US-West may experience..." keep neutral and no promises.

Ana (product): add scope line: "affects hosted generation (text & streaming) in us-west; embeddings unaffected."

L10nBot: Need short two-line copy for translations and SMS alerts. keep sentences under 140 chars.

Sasha (ops): noted. I'll wait for legal signoff then publish. tagging @Jamie :thumbsup: 

Jamie (legal): approved.

Maya (oncall): rolling restarts done on 4 nodes, CPU back to ~45%. region-fallback active. error rate dropping to ~0.8%.

Tom (support): sent targeted update to flagged enterprise accounts. canned reply posted to support KB.

Sasha (ops): publishing initial statuspage update now.

IncidentBot: statuspage update published: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-2026-0789 — initial notice posted at 09:28 UTC.

(16 minutes later)

Maya (oncall): follow-up: error rate back to baseline, latency normalizing. continuing to monitor for 30m.

Sasha (ops): preparing resolved notice text.

Sasha (ops): resolved draft:

```
Resolved — Generation API in US-West: The increased latency and 5xx errors have been resolved as of 09:46 UTC. We implemented rolling restarts and enabled regional fallback routing during mitigation. No customer data was lost. If you continue to see any issues, please contact support. Incident ID: INC-2026-0789.
```

Ana (product): looks good.

Jamie (legal): approved.

Maya (oncall): marking incident resolved. final metrics: peak error rate 3.2% at 09:14 UTC, duration ~34 minutes.

Sasha (ops): publishing resolved notice.

IncidentBot: statuspage update published: resolved at 09:46 UTC. Incident closed.

Tom (support): creating post-incident summary for customers and filing internal RCA ticket assigned to Raj (eng-sre).
